rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday word for an upholstered sofa.

example.english: The sofa is really comfortable to sit on.
example.jyutping: zoeng1 so1 faa3 co5 dak1 hou2 syu1 fuk6

rows.note: A speaker uses this fuller term when explicitly treating the sofa as a type of seat or distinguishing it from other furniture.

example.english: This sofa is much more comfortable than an ordinary chair.
example.traditional: 呢張梳化椅比普通椅舒服好多。
example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 so1 faa3 ji2 bei2 pou2 tung1 ji2 syu1 fuk6 hou2 do1
